summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting daily open-market repurchases under its previously announced board-approved share buyback programme. Between 3 and 9 September 2026 the bank bought 12,800,000 ordinary shares across XMAD, CEUX, TQEX and AQEU, with weighted average prices of roughly EUR 12.55 to EUR 12.86 per share. Cumulative cash deployed reached EUR 468,982,200, about 25.7% of the programme's maximum investment, and approximately 18.2% of shares outstanding as of 2021 have been repurchased. Watch execution pace, remaining authorization and EPS accretion.
